title: The Trial of Sacred Flame
intro: In an ancient land where devotion to carved stone had taken root in every home, one individual stood apart. Through unwavering conviction and divine protection, they faced what should have been certain death — and walked away unharmed. Can you uncover the identity of this remarkable soul?
clues: I was raised among people who bowed to idols they had carved with their own hands, believing these objects held divine power.
When I challenged their beliefs, they dismissed me at first, but I could not remain silent about the truth I knew.
On a day when they were gathered away, I destroyed their idols, leaving only the largest one untouched.
When they returned and saw what I had done, their leaders commanded a great pyre to be built, intending to cast me into the flames.
They hurled me into the blazing fire, but the Lord of the worlds commanded it to become cool and safe for me.
I emerged from the flames completely unharmed, while those who plotted against me faced utter ruin.
